description: The 24 named memes of T2 (planted stories, natural sentences) and T3 (Tier A = the orphan-vigilante layer). Every method receives the same inputs for a meme: its label, its definition (LLM methods only) and the 5 example sentences, written in the meme's usual words (explicit wording). 'keywords' are the words people usually use for the meme: they are the ban list for the banned, implicit and control versions of planted stories, and a reference list for keyword quality checks; they are NOT given to any keyword method (keyword methods choose their own queries: TF-IDF from the examples, or an LLM given label, definition and examples). Matching uses analysis.stem on token sequences, so inflections count. dev_unit_qwen: the DEV-labelled Qwen3-8B unit used for H3 (see dev_units.json for the Llama counterpart). Examples were written for this pre-registration on 2026-10-20 and are frozen; they contain no names and use varied settings.

tiers.A: orphan-vigilante family layer (Mike Taylor's earlier book pp. 21-22)

memes.label: Secret identity
memes.definition: A character hides who they really are behind a mask or disguise and leads a double life, so the people around them do not know they are the hidden figure.
examples: By day the quiet schoolteacher marks essays, but by night she leads the rebel raids in a mask, and no one in the village suspects her secret identity.
The ship's cook is revealed to be the masked raider whose double life has fooled the admiralty for years.
He hides his true identity even from his fiancee, slipping into his disguise each evening before riding out.
When the masked rider is finally unmasked in the square, the crowd gasps to see the mayor's mild-mannered son.
Only her grandmother knows that the timid librarian and the hooded outlaw are the same person, an alter ego she has kept for ten years.
memes.decoy_hint: a masked ball, a mask in a museum, a disguise for a costume party, an identity card

memes.label: The origin wound
memes.definition: As a child, a character witnesses or suffers a traumatic loss, typically the murder of their parents, and that loss sets them on the path that defines their life.
examples: As a boy he watched a robber shoot both his parents in an alley, and the trauma of that night shapes every choice he makes as a man.
Orphaned at eight when raiders killed her mother and father, she grows up determined that no other child will suffer the same loss.
The childhood memory of seeing his parents killed on the road home drives the knight's lifelong crusade against highwaymen.
She was ten when she witnessed her parents' murder, and that night turned her into a relentless investigator.
Years after the fire that killed his family, the orphaned engineer still relives the night it happened, and it is why he builds his machines.
memes.decoy_hint: a murder mystery game at a party, happy childhood memories, a witness at a trial about a stolen horse

memes.label: Heir to a dead father's fortune
memes.definition: After a parent dies, usually the father, a young character inherits the family's great fortune or company.
examples: When his father dies suddenly, the young man inherits the family shipping company and a fortune he never wanted.
The heiress returns from abroad after her father's death to take control of the estate and its mills.
At twenty-one he becomes heir to his late father's railway empire and all the wealth that comes with it.
Her inheritance from her dead father makes her the richest woman in the province overnight.
The reading of the will names the dead tycoon's only son as heir to the whole fortune, including the steelworks and the mansion.
memes.decoy_hint: a fortune teller, a real-estate agent, inheriting a grandmother's recipe, a small family business that is thriving

memes.label: The wealthy vigilante
memes.definition: A rich character uses their money to fight crime or injustice themselves, outside the law.
examples: The billionaire spends his nights as a vigilante, using his money to hunt the criminals the courts cannot touch.
A wealthy widow funds her own private war on the smugglers, taking the law into her own hands when the magistrates fail.
Bored with high society, the rich young lord becomes a vigilante who punishes cruel landlords outside the law.
The millionaire inventor uses his money and his gadgets to fight crime in the city's slums.
The wealthy banker who funds the opera also roams the docks at night as a vigilante, beating up loan sharks.
memes.decoy_hint: a rich dessert, a millionaire's charity gala, a neighbourhood watch meeting about parking

memes.label: The servant who raised the orphan
memes.definition: A loyal servant, such as a butler, steward or housekeeper, raises an orphaned child and stays on as their confidant and surrogate parent.
examples: After the boy's parents die, the family butler raises him as his own and stays at his side into adulthood.
The old housekeeper who brought her up after her mother's death is the only person she trusts with her plans.
His loyal manservant, who raised him from the age of six, patches his wounds and scolds him like a father.
The castle steward becomes the young prince's surrogate father after the king and queen die, teaching him to ride and to keep his temper.
Raised by the family's devoted butler, the young captain still asks his advice before every important decision.
memes.decoy_hint: a hotel butler who serves a guest dinner, a ship's steward handing out blankets, a housekeeper hired for a week

memes.label: Taking in an orphan as a ward
memes.definition: An established or wealthy adult takes in an orphaned child as a ward, and the child becomes an apprentice or partner.
examples: The merchant takes in the orphaned circus boy as his ward and trains him in the trade.
After the girl's parents are killed, the old sea captain becomes her legal guardian and brings her aboard as his ward.
He adopts the street orphan who tried to steal his horse, and the boy becomes his loyal partner.
The duchess takes the orphan in as her ward and secretly teaches her the family's sword techniques.
As guardian of two orphaned brothers, the inventor raises them in his workshop and makes them his assistants.
memes.decoy_hint: a hospital ward, adopting a stray dog, a legal guardian signing a school form for a child whose parents are alive

memes.label: The foppish facade
memes.definition: To hide a secret mission, a hero behaves in public like a frivolous, lazy, foolish or cowardly idler so that no one takes them seriously.
examples: In the salons he plays a foolish dandy who faints at the sight of a sword, so no one suspects he leads the rebels.
She cultivates a reputation as a frivolous party girl, which hides the long nights she spends exposing the governor's crimes.
The young lord pretends to be a lazy fop, yawning through council meetings while he plans the governor's downfall.
Everyone at court mocks the prince as a cowardly idler, which is exactly what he wants them to believe.
By posing as a shallow playboy more interested in yachts than politics, the senator's son keeps his enemies from looking closer.
memes.decoy_hint: a genuinely lazy cousin, a dandy at a fashion show, a building's restored facade

memes.label: A symbol to strike fear
memes.definition: A fighter against crime deliberately adopts a frightening costume, symbol or legend so that criminals are terrified of them.
examples: Knowing that criminals are a superstitious lot, he designs a frightening costume to terrify them.
She paints a skull on her armour so that the bandits will fear her before she draws her sword.
The hunter spreads the legend of a wolf spirit in the forest, and soon the poachers are too frightened to enter.
He chooses the shape of a wolf for his cloak because the smugglers dread wolves more than they dread the law.
To strike terror into the gangs, the detective turns himself into a symbol they whisper about, a shadow that appears whenever they strike.
memes.decoy_hint: a costume party, a child's fear of the dark, a company logo chosen as a symbol of trust

memes.label: The hidden lair
memes.definition: A hero keeps a secret headquarters hidden beneath or behind their home, full of equipment for their mission.
examples: Beneath the manor lies a hidden cave where he keeps his weapons, maps and horses.
A secret passage behind the bookcase leads to her underground headquarters full of radios and files.
The lighthouse keeper's cellar is really a lair packed with diving gear and charts of the smugglers' routes.
Under the farmhouse he digs a secret base where he repairs the stolen machines.
Behind the waterfall is a cavern the rebels use as their hideout, reached through a hidden door in the mill.
memes.decoy_hint: a tourist cave tour, a company headquarters with a lobby, an underground train station

memes.label: Taking up the mantle
memes.definition: A successor takes over a hero's identity, title or role after the original retires, dies or is disabled, and continues their legacy.
examples: After the old champion is crippled, his student takes up the mantle and rides out in his armour.
When the first protector of the valley dies, her daughter puts on her armour and carries on her legacy.
The retired swordsman passes on his title and his sword to a young successor who must prove worthy of the legacy.
A street kid finds the fallen ranger's badge and decides to carry on his work as the new ranger of the valley.
Too old to fight, the aging champion hands his helmet to his student, who takes up the mantle in his place.
memes.decoy_hint: a fireplace mantle, a CEO's chosen successor at a bank, a family legacy of baking bread

memes.label: A coin flip decides a fate
memes.definition: A character lets the toss of a coin decide someone's fate, often whether they live or die.
examples: The outlaw flips a coin to decide whether the stagecoach driver lives or dies.
She lets a coin toss settle whether the traitor will hang, and it comes up heads.
Holding a pistol to the banker's head, he says that only the coin will decide, and flips it into the air.
The embittered judge now decides every verdict by tossing a coin, heads for freedom and tails for the gallows.
Before each robbery the gang leader flips his lucky coin to choose which hostage to release.
memes.decoy_hint: a coin collector appraising a rare coin, flipping pancakes, a lucky charm, heads of state

memes.label: The vat of chemicals
memes.definition: A character falls or is pushed into a vat or tank of chemicals or toxic waste, which disfigures or transforms them.
examples: During the chase through the chemical plant, the thief falls into a vat of chemicals and emerges with bleached white skin.
Pushed into a tank of toxic waste at the dye factory, the foreman survives but is horribly disfigured.
The scientist tumbles into a vat of bubbling acid, and when he climbs out his face is permanently changed.
A fall into the refinery's chemical vat leaves the smuggler with green hair and a frozen smile.
She is thrown into a vat of chemicals at the tannery, and the accident gives her strange new strength.
memes.decoy_hint: a wine vat at a harvest festival, a chemistry class experiment, a fish tank, toxic gossip

memes.label: A funeral
memes.definition: Mourners gather at the funeral or burial of a character, including a staged funeral for someone who is not really dead.
examples: The whole village attends the miner's funeral, and his widow throws the first handful of earth into the grave.
At the graveside the boy will not cry while the mourners sing over his father's coffin.
The admiral's funeral is held at sea, and his casket is lowered into the waves as the crew salutes.
She delivers the eulogy at her rival's burial, though she suspects he is not really dead.
Rain falls on the cemetery as the family buries the old king beside his wife.
memes.decoy_hint: burying treasure, a grave mistake, a funeral home's accounts, a dog burying a bone

memes.label: The morbid joke
memes.definition: A villain treats killing and suffering as comedy: laughing, telling jokes or staging crimes as pranks.
examples: The killer leaves a joke card at every crime scene and laughs at the investigators over the radio.
Laughing as the building burns, the villain tells the hostages that the fire is the punchline of his best joke.
He sets the banquet hall's chandelier to fall and calls it his greatest prank, giggling as the guests scatter.
To the bandit every killing is a gag, and he tells a joke before each execution.
The failed comedian turns his crimes into a twisted stand-up routine, laughing at his victims' screams.
memes.decoy_hint: friends laughing at a wedding toast, a clown at a child's birthday party, a harmless office prank

memes.label: Losing the protege
memes.definition: The hero's young apprentice or sidekick is captured, tortured or killed, and the hero is consumed by grief or guilt.
examples: The villain beats the hero's young sidekick to death, and the hero blames himself for sending the boy alone.
When her apprentice is killed in the ambush, the swordswoman is consumed by guilt and gives up the fight.
He finds his protege's body in the warehouse and never forgives himself.
The captain's young partner is tortured by the smugglers, and the captain's grief turns into cold fury.
Years after losing his pupil to the assassin, the old knight still keeps the boy's broken sword above his bed.
memes.decoy_hint: an apprentice who graduates with honours, a pupil who wins a prize, grief for a pet goldfish

memes.label: A corrupt police force
memes.definition: An honest officer stands against a police force or city watch that has been corrupted by organised crime.
examples: The new sergeant soon learns that half the precinct is on the mob's payroll and that he is the only honest cop left.
The city watch takes bribes from the smugglers, so the young officer must gather evidence against her own captain.
Corrupt detectives frame the honest lieutenant for the killing because he would not take the gang's money.
Every police officer in the port town is crooked except the old constable, who keeps a notebook of their bribes.
When the honest inspector reports the corruption, his superiors hand his file to the crime boss.
memes.decoy_hint: a police officer helping a lost child, a corrupted computer file, a company payroll error

memes.label: The fear toxin
memes.definition: A villain uses a gas, drug or poison that makes victims hallucinate their worst fears.
examples: The doctor releases a gas that makes the guards hallucinate their worst fears until they flee screaming.
Exposed to the toxin, she sees her dead brother crawling toward her and collapses in terror.
The witch's powder makes the soldiers see their nightmares come alive.
His fear gas spreads through the water supply, and the whole town panics at visions of fire and spiders.
Sprayed with a hallucinogen, the detective believes the walls are closing in and can barely breathe.
memes.decoy_hint: a gas leak in a kitchen that is fixed, a child's nightmare after a scary story, stage fright before a concert

memes.label: The mass breakout
memes.definition: The inmates of a prison or asylum are released all at once, unleashing dangerous criminals.
examples: The villain blows open the prison walls and releases every inmate into the city.
During the riot the asylum's cells are unlocked and hundreds of patients pour into the streets.
The rebels storm the fortress jail and set free all the prisoners, including the most dangerous murderers.
A mass jailbreak on the colony moon frees the convicts, who seize the mining town.
After the power fails, the inmates escape the island prison together, and the coast is overrun.
memes.decoy_hint: an escape room game, a political asylum interview, blood cells under a microscope, a prisoner of war's letters

memes.label: The hero refuses to kill
memes.definition: Given the chance to kill the villain, the hero refuses on principle and spares them.
examples: With the tyrant at her sword's point, she refuses to kill him and hands him over to the court.
He spares the murderer's life, saying he will never kill, not even a man like that.
The gunslinger lowers his revolver and lets the outlaw live, refusing to become a killer.
Although the assassin begs to be finished off, the knight shows him mercy and binds his wounds.
She could push him off the cliff, but she will not kill, so she pulls him back up.
memes.decoy_hint: spare parts for a car, a spare room, a nurse's mercy dash to a hospital, refusing a dinner invitation

memes.label: The race for an antidote
memes.definition: A poison or toxin threatens victims, and the heroes race against time to make or obtain an antidote.
examples: When the princess is poisoned, the alchemist has until dawn to brew the antidote.
The doctor races against time to make a cure before the toxin kills the whole crew.
Bitten by the snake, the scout will die unless his friends find the antidote in the enemy's camp.
The villain poisons the reservoir, and the chemist must make enough serum for the city in a single night.
With the poison spreading through his veins, the agent breaks into the laboratory to steal the only dose of the cure.
memes.decoy_hint: curing ham in a smokehouse, a daily vitamin dose, poison ivy in a garden that is weeded

memes.label: The revenge vow
memes.definition: A character vows to avenge a murdered family member or loved one.
examples: Standing over her father's body, she swears revenge on the men who killed him.
He vows to avenge his slain brother and spends ten years hunting the killers.
The widow swears vengeance on the landlord who had her husband hanged.
Sworn to avenge his family, the boy trains with the mountain monks until he is a man.
She vows retribution against the clan that burned her village.
memes.decoy_hint: wedding vows, swearing in a new mayor, a payback of a bank loan

memes.label: Mistaken twins
memes.definition: Identical twins or exact look-alikes are mistaken for one another, causing confusion.
examples: The merchant's identical twin arrives in town, and the merchant's wife mistakes him for her husband.
Separated at birth, the twins are confused with each other all over the city, and each is accused of the other's debts.
The guards arrest the wrong brother, mistaking him for his identical twin.
Because she looks exactly like the missing duchess, the maid is mistaken for her at the ball.
The look-alike prince is taken for the real one and crowned by mistake.
memes.decoy_hint: twin beds in a hotel room, a double espresso, a mistaken delivery address, identical houses on a street

memes.label: The death-feigning potion
memes.definition: A character takes a potion or drug that makes them appear dead, in order to escape a fate.
examples: To avoid the forced marriage, she drinks a potion that makes her seem dead for two days.
The friar gives him a sleeping draught that slows his heart so that everyone believes he has died.
The captive swallows a drug that fakes his death, and the guards carry his body out of the fortress.
Her family weeps over her lifeless body, not knowing the sleeping potion will wear off at midnight.
He takes a potion to feign death so that his enemies will stop hunting him.
memes.decoy_hint: a love potion at a fair, a sleeping cat, a drug trial for headaches, a lifeless party

memes.label: A deal with the devil
memes.definition: A character makes a bargain with a demon or other supernatural being, gaining power or success at the cost of their soul or a terrible price.
examples: Desperate for fame, the fiddler sells his soul to the devil at the crossroads.
She makes a pact with a demon who grants her the throne in exchange for her firstborn.
The failing farmer signs his name in blood for a stranger who promises rain, at the price of his soul.
In return for winning every hand, the gambler bargains away his soul to a smiling demon.
The king strikes a deal with the devil to win the war, and the debt comes due on his deathbed.
memes.decoy_hint: a bargain at a flea market, a soul singer's concert, a devil's food cake, a trade pact between two towns
